reports.name: Attendance
Not Attending
reports.query:
SELECT e.BadgeNumber,
       e.NAME
FROM Employee AS e
WHERE ISNULL(e.DeletedFromDevice,0) = 0
AND PositionId = 1
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Attendance AS a
        WHERE a.BadgeNumber = e.BadgeNumber
          AND a.Status = 'Check-In'
          AND a.VerifyTime > {{FromDate}}
          AND a.VerifyTime < DATEADD(DAY,1,{{ToDate}})
  )
ORDER BY e.NAME ASC

reports.name: FirstIN LastOut
reports.query:
SELECT
    E.Id AS EmployeeId,
    E.BadgeNumber,
    E.[NAME] AS EmployeeName,
    CONVERT(date, A.VerifyTime) AS AttendanceDate,
    MIN(CASE WHEN A.StatusId = 0 THEN A.VerifyTime END) AS FirstCheckIn,
    MAX(CASE WHEN A.StatusId = 1 THEN A.VerifyTime END) AS LastCheckOut
FROM [TimeKeeping].[dbo].[Employee] AS E
INNER JOIN [TimeKeeping].[dbo].[Attendance] AS A
    ON A.BadgeNumber = E.BadgeNumber
WHERE A.VerifyTime >= CAST({{FromDate}} AS date)
  AND A.VerifyTime < DATEADD(
        day,
        1,
        CAST({{ToDate}} AS date)
      )
GROUP BY
    E.Id,
    E.BadgeNumber,
    E.[NAME],
    CONVERT(date, A.VerifyTime)
ORDER BY
    AttendanceDate,
    E.[NAME];

reports.name: On Prem
reports.query:
WITH LatestTransaction AS (
    SELECT
        A.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY A.BadgeNumber
            ORDER BY A.VerifyTime DESC, A.Id DESC
        ) AS RowNum
    FROM dbo.Attendance AS A
    WHERE A.VerifyTime >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
      AND A.VerifyTime < DATEADD(day, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
)
SELECT TOP ({{limit}})
    E.BadgeNumber,
    E.NAME AS EmployeeName,
    L.VerifyTime AS LastTransactionTime,
    L.Status AS LastTransactionStatus
FROM LatestTransaction AS L
LEFT JOIN dbo.Employee AS E
    ON E.BadgeNumber = L.BadgeNumber
WHERE L.RowNum = 1
  AND L.Status = 'Check-In'
ORDER BY L.VerifyTime DESC;

reports.name: Off Prem
reports.query:
WITH LatestTransaction AS (
    SELECT
        A.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY A.BadgeNumber
            ORDER BY A.VerifyTime DESC, A.Id DESC
        ) AS RowNum
    FROM dbo.Attendance AS A
    WHERE A.VerifyTime >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
      AND A.VerifyTime < DATEADD(day, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
)
SELECT TOP ({{limit}})
    E.BadgeNumber,
    E.NAME AS EmployeeName,
    L.VerifyTime AS LastTransactionTime,
    L.Status AS LastTransactionStatus
FROM LatestTransaction AS L
LEFT JOIN dbo.Employee AS E
    ON E.BadgeNumber = L.BadgeNumber
WHERE L.RowNum = 1
  AND L.Status = 'Check-Out'
ORDER BY L.VerifyTime DESC;
